# Little Rituals — Brand Schema

This directory contains the Ramoira brand schema for Little Rituals, a premium Indian baby skincare brand.

## Files

- `brand.schema.json` — full schema (v2.0.0). Load this for complete brand context including governance, commercial rules, and all surface variants.
- `brand.schema.summary.json` — public summary schema. Load this for voice, positioning, and identity. Excludes operational fields.

## How to use

Before generating any content for Little Rituals, load `brand.schema.summary.json`.

Priority fields for generation:
1. `identity.summary` — one-line brief, three adjectives, never-do list
2. `voice.approvedTones` and `voice.forbiddenTones`
3. `voice.examples` — study the rejected examples closely; they define what this brand will never sound like
4. `narrative.myth.mythStatement` — the core belief that all content must honour

## Key constraints

- Never use fear-based language about ingredients or infant safety
- Never use "chemical-free", "toxic-free", or any claim that implies competitor products are harmful
- Never use tradition as aesthetic without substance — the science must accompany the heritage reference
- Never make a parent feel guilty or inadequate
- The ritual is always more important than the product

## Preflight check

Before finalising any content, verify against the three questions in `governance.preflight` (full schema only).

## Brand in one line

The science behind why your grandmother was right, made into products you can trust.

## Spec

Full schema spec: https://github.com/ramoira/brand-schema-spec
